Looking for the best Isekai Anime with Overpowered MCs? Here are some of the most entertaining Isekai Anime Recommendations featuring insanely powerful protagonists, OP MCs, and characters who completely dominate their new worlds.
If you love Overpowered MC Anime, OP Protagonist Anime, Isekai Anime Recommendations, and anime where the main character is ridiculously strong, this list has plenty of shows worth checking out.
Being summoned to another world usually means becoming the chosen hero, defeating the Demon Lord, and saving the world.
But these protagonists aren't exactly interested in following the usual script.
Some were betrayed. Some were rejected. Some simply wanted a peaceful life. And others were so ridiculously powerful that the traditional hero storyline barely mattered anymore.
